say.speaker: mentor
say.text: Good! You stayed on your feet, {partner}. Now {healer}, mend {partner}'s bruises with Heal Pulse before the next exchange.

say.speaker: healer
say.text: Leave it to me! One warm pulse and {partner} will be good as new!

say.speaker: mentor
say.text: And {lord}, watch my stance! Every Pokemon can carry up to four moves and learns stronger ones by leveling up.

say.speaker: mentor
say.text: You can mark one Physical move [E] for Range 1 counters and one Special move [E] for Range 2 counters. Right now I only have a Physical move equipped, so strike me from two spaces away with Dragon Breath and I cannot hit back!
